setup: Set the pad so your chin clears the top
Chest on the pad, feet braced
Grip the handles, arms hanging long
execution: Pull your elbows back past your ribs
Keep your chest on the pad
Lower slowly to a full stretch
faults: Don't lift your chest off to heave it

notes: Load plates evenly on each side, and unload the same way.
Climb on and off carefully; let the handles fully down before stepping away.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Elbows pulled back past the torso, handles near the lower chest. Shoulder blades squeezed together, chest still on the pad.
